=== bra to the next instruction
 bra next
next: nop
=== an unsized bra stays at 16 bits in GNU syntax
back: nop
 bra back
 bsr fwd
 beq back
 nop
fwd: rts
=== jbsr, jra and jbCC relax
top: nop
 jeq top
 jne top
 jbne top
 jcc top
 jmi top
 jpl top
 jbsr top
 jra top
 jbra top
 jbls top
=== explicit branch sizes
top: nop
 bras top
 brab top
 bra.b top
 bsrs top
 bsrw top
 bsrl top
 blsw top
 bhss top
 beql top
=== jra relaxes to 16 and 32 bits
 jra mid
 jbsr far
 .space 200
mid: .space 40000
far: rts
=== undefined targets
 bsr ext
 jbsr ext
 jra ext
 jbeq ext
 jsr ext
=== DBcc loops
 moveq #9,%d0
1: moveb %a0@+,%a1@+
 dbra %d0,1b
 dbhs %d1,1b
 dbeq %d2,1b
 rts
=== local labels forward and back
1: nop
 jra 2f
 jra 1b
2: rts
=== PC-relative references to labels
 lea data(%pc),%a0
 movew data(%pc),%d0
 movew %pc@(data),%d0
 movew data(%pc,%d1:w),%d2
 movew %pc@(data,%d1:l),%d2
 pea back(%pc)
 jsr %pc@(back)
back: rts
data: .word 1,2,3
=== PC-relative references to undefined symbols
 lea ext(%pc),%a0
 movew ext(%pc,%d0:w),%d1
=== constants defined before and after use
 .set BASE, 0xdff000
 movew #0x7fff,BASE+0x96
 lea BASE,%a5
 movew #0x8200,%a5@(0x96)
 movew %d0,FWD
 jsr %a6@(FWD)
 movew %a0@(FWD,%d0:w),%d1
 .set FWD, -30
=== GNU syntax aligns nothing
 .byte 1
 rts
 .byte 2
 movew %d0,%d1
=== comments and statement separators
# a hash comment in the first column
 movew #1,%d0 | a trailing comment
 movew #2,%d1 ; movew #3,%d2
 /* a block comment */ nop
=== a function with a frame
f: linkw %fp,#-8
 moveml %d2-%d3/%a2,%sp@-
 movel %fp@(8),%d0
 movel %d0,%fp@(-4)
 moveml %sp@+,%d2-%d3/%a2
 unlk %fp
 rts
=== code alignment pads with zeroes
 .byte 1
 .balign 8
 rts
 .balign 8
=== FPU and MMU branches: fixed sizes, and fj/pb relaxing
top: fnop
 fbeq top
 fbnel top
 fjgt top
 fjogl mid
 pbbs top
 pbbsw top
 pbbs mid
 fdbne %d0,top
 pdbws %d1,top
 .space 40000
mid: rts
=== fjCC and pbCC to undefined symbols take 32 bits
 fjeq ext
 fjne ext
 pbls ext
 fbeq ext
 fdbeq %d7,ext
=== a DBcc beyond reach becomes dbcc, bra.s and bra.l
 dbra %d0,far
 dbeq %d1,near
near: nop
 .space 40000
far: rts
=== a DBcc to an undefined symbol
 dbra %d0,ext
 dbhi %d1,ext
=== jra, jbsr and jbCC to a number jump absolutely
 jra 0x1000
 jbsr 0x12345678
 jbne 0x8000
 jbgt 0xfffffffe
=== memory-indirect displacements of zero are left out
 movel ([0,%a0],%d1.l,0),%d0
 movel ([0,%a0]),%d1
 movel ([4,%a0],0),%d2
 movel ([%a0],%d3.w,0),%d3
 faddx ([0,%a1],%d1.l*4,0),%fp0
=== fsave, frestore and the MMU's save and restore
 fsave -(%sp)
 frestore (%sp)+
 psave -(%sp)
 prestore (%sp)+
 fsave %a0@(8)
 frestore %a1@
=== an FPU exception handler's register frame
 fmovem.x %fp0-%fp7,-(%sp)
 fmovem.l %fpcr/%fpsr/%fpiar,-(%sp)
 fmove.l %fpsr,%d0
 andil #0xff00,%d0
 fmove.l %d0,%fpsr
 fmovem.l (%sp)+,%fpcr/%fpsr/%fpiar
 fmovem.x (%sp)+,%fp0-%fp7
 rte
